name: MagicLab MagicBot D1
summary: A wheeled industrial humanoid from MagicLab for standardised factory work, precision assembly and shelf picking, shown in Europe at IFA 2026.

germany.statusNote: No German seller lists D1 with a price; MagicLab says it has sales and support teams in Germany, Italy and Spain, so ask MagicLab. MagicLab states CE-RED certification is targeted for Q4 2026; check CE status before use in Germany.

notes: MagicLab states CE-RED certification is targeted for Q4 2026; check CE status before use in Germany.
Omnidirectional wheeled chassis with a waist-leg structure to handle material from 0.8 to 2.3 m height; hot-swap charging (IFA 2026 press release).
The manufacturer now publishes a MagicBot D1 specification table. Per-arm payload is described as a maximum; runtime mode and load conditions are unstated.
A two-finger gripper is explicitly included. Dexterous-hand compatibility is listed separately and does not establish dexterous-hand inclusion.
Base and high compute editions are separate configurations. The dossier does not select one; the high-compute table and prose use inconsistent TOPS/TFLOPS units.
Manufacturer content conflicts on ultrasonic sensor count (table 3, prose 8) and calls the head camera RGB in the table but RGB-D in prose.
Overall protection is IP42; arm-only protection is IP50. Neither rating by itself establishes outdoor suitability.
The charging dock is optional. Hot-swappable batteries and docking support are manufacturer features, not proof of customer deployment.

openQuestions: Which runtime test, operating mode and load produced the stated 4 hours?
Which compute edition is supplied in the quoted German configuration, and are the high-compute units TOPS (FP4) or TFLOPS?
Does the delivered chassis have 3 or 8 ultrasonic sensors, and is the head camera RGB or RGB-D?
What does the published 1-1 cm-level navigation-mapping statement mean?
Which SDK, API and ROS versions are supported?
Are outdoor operation and rough terrain supported for the exact delivered configuration?
What is the price and confirmed lead time for the delivered configuration in Germany?
